subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 4: I want to be a doctor!
outcomes: I can say: I want to be a / an … and I want to travel by …
I can complete a jobs and transport crossword.
I can describe people's jobs from pictures.

tf.s: We say: I want to travel by train.
We say: I want to travel by a motorbike.
tf.why: No a after by: by motorbike.

tf.s: We say: I want to be an astronaut.
We say: I want to be an chef.
tf.why: chef starts with a consonant sound: a chef.

tf.s: In the game, you take turns.
A rocket goes with a chef.
tf.why: A rocket goes with an astronaut.

tf.s: A person who likes children can want to be a teacher.
bus, train and motorbike are jobs.

o: I want to be a chef.
I want to be an chef.
boxes.why: I want to be a chef.

o: I want to travel by train.
I want to be a train.
I want to travel by a train.
boxes.why: I want to travel by train.

boxes.q: Choose: I want to be a / an astronaut.
Complete: I want to ___ by motorbike.
boxes.why: I want to travel by motorbike.

boxes.q: Clue: I go by … (a red bus)
Clue: I like children and I want to be a …
Picture: a man in overalls with a helmet. He's a ___.
Picture: a man in a pilot uniform. He's a ___.
Which square is a good new game square?
boxes.why: A game square has a job and a transport.

mcq.q: Spell the job for: Her uncle is an … (rocket)
What do you say for the spinner: nurse?
o: I want to be a nurse.
I want to be an nurse.
I want to travel by nurse.

mcq.q: Picture: a woman with a car at a school. Complete: She's a ___.
mcq.why: She works at a school: a teacher.

mcq.q: Picture: a man in a pilot uniform at the bus stop. Which sentence is right?
o: He goes to work by bus.
She goes to work by bus.
He goes to work by plane.
He go to work by bus.
mcq.why: He is at the bus stop: He goes to work by bus.

mcq.q: Make two sentences about your dream.
o: I want to be an astronaut. I want to travel by boat.
I want to be a astronaut. I want to travel by boat.
I want to be an astronaut. I want travel by boat.
I want be an astronaut. I want to travel by a boat.
mcq.why: an astronaut, travel by boat: all correct.

mcq.q: Which new game square is correct?
o: I want to be a builder. I want to travel by car.
I want to be a car. I want to travel by builder.
I want to be an builder. I want to travel by car.
I want to be a builder. I want to travel by a car.
mcq.why: Job with a / an, then by + transport.

mcq.q: The pilot is at the bus stop. What does this tell you?
o: He goes to work by bus.
mcq.why: The bus stop shows his transport.

mcq.q: Why do we say 'travel by' but 'be a'?
o: We travel by transport and we are a job.
mcq.why: Jobs follow be a / an. Transport follows travel by.
